action.content:
Hey Lightning McQueen, or should I say, $v = \text{fast}$?
I heard your top speed is approaching $\infty$, but please remember that $\lim_{t \to \text{finish}} \text{tires} \neq 0$.
If you keep racing at $c$ (the speed of light), you might just turn into a photon and miss the trophy ceremony entirely!
Just a friendly reminder: $\text{Pit Stop} + \text{Oil Change} > \text{Flat Tire} \times \text{Embarrassment}$.
Keep those wheels spinning, but maybe solve for $x$ where $x = \text{caution}$ before the next curve. P.P.S. If you see a math problem on the racetrack, don't try to solve it at 200 mph; just drive around it!
